fact: In the December 2024 WAPIS newsletter the director of Côte d'Ivoire's CTIP, M. Doumbia, says the country still intends to put in place the Système d'information policière de Côte d'Ivoire (SIPCI) through the CTIP under the Minister of the Interior and Security, that collection should start from the commissariats and brigades, and that it is essential to design a national software for drafting procès-verbaux or recording police information.
title: SIPAO Lettre d'information, numéro double 25-26, décembre 2024
